items.title: Incorrect price calculation formula
items.summary: Fix incorrect total price calculation formula by changing addition to multiplication.
test:
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from inventory import total_price

items = [
    ("apple", 10, 2), # 10 * 2 = 20
    ("banana", 5, 3)  # 5 * 3 = 15
]

assert total_price(items) == 35, f"Expected 35, got {total_price(items)}"

items.title: Incorrect loop termination in find_item
items.summary: Move the `return None` statement outside of the `for` loop to fix incorrect loop termination in `find_item`.
test:
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from inventory import find_item

items = [("apple", 1, 10), ("banana", 2, 5)]
result = find_item(items, "banana")

assert result == ("banana", 2, 5), f"Expected ('banana', 2, 5), but got {result}"

items.title: Incorrect sorting order in top_n
items.summary: Change top_n to return the n largest values by sorting in descending order.
test:
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from inventory import top_n

values = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
n = 3
result = top_n(values, n)
expected = [5, 4, 3]

assert result == expected, f"Expected {expected}, but got {result}"
